name: Tin Star
description: The story of Jim Worth, an expat British police officer starting a new life with his family as police chief in Little Big Bear, an idyllic town near the Rocky Mountains. When his small town is overrun by migrant workers from a massive new oil refinery – the wave of drugs, prostitution and organised crime that follows them threatens to sweep away everything in its wake.

videos.title: The Dark Heart Of Tin Star
Fun and (S)laughter
videos.overview: An alcoholic, small-town police chief has his hopes for a fresh start and a quiet life shattered by unspeakable tragedy.

videos.title: The Kid
videos.overview: Wracked by guilt, Jim attempts to bury his grief by picking the murder case back up, instinctively believing it is connected to his own loss.

videos.title: Comfort of Strangers
videos.overview: Waking up after a blackout, Jim discovers that Anna has disappeared. Meanwhile, Whitey tidies up a loose end.

videos.title: Jack
videos.overview: The Worth family reunite to say goodbye to a loved one. Mrs Bradshaw faces a difficult decision after she learns a damaging story has leaked to the press.

videos.title: Bait
videos.overview: With Jim banished from their home, Angela takes her family's safety into her own hands. Whitey executes a ruthless plan to bring Jim into his sights.

videos.title: Cuckoo
videos.overview: Whitey visits the Worth home to exact revenge, but finds himself on the back foot. Elizabeth confronts Gagnon about his interest in bringing down Jim.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: Whitey and Anna grow closer, as Angela calls on Jack to finish what she asked for. Elizabeth uncovers a dreadful event at a nearby reserve.

videos.title: This Be The Verse
videos.overview: Jack looks to interrogate Frank, while Anna tries to escape Little Big Bear. Elizabeth finds a key witness, but Gagnon exploits her weakness.

videos.title: Fortunate Boy
videos.overview: The truth is revealed. Somewhere in the English countryside, Jack Devlin works a case that will have tragic repercussions.

videos.title: My Love Is Vengeance
videos.overview: Leaving a trail of broken promises behind him, Jack sets out to take his revenge, while Angela looks to bring Anna home.

videos.title: Prairie Gothic
videos.overview: Horrified by her actions, Anna decides to flee, and Jack fights back for his family. Meanwhile, Elizabeth Bradshaw attempts to forget her traumatic ordeal, but relief is cut short by the delivery of her letter of termination

videos.title: Resist Not Evil
videos.overview: Anna takes refuge with the Ammonite Nickel family in their strict religious community.

videos.title: Consequences
videos.overview:
Johan is plunged into crisis and Rosa reveals her plans for the future to Anna.

[Elizabeth and Johan's Story]

videos.title: Jack and Coke
videos.overview:
Jack attempts to burn his past by drinking whiskey on the mountainside.

[Jack and Angela's Story]

videos.title: The Bagman Cometh
videos.overview: We learn the story of the Nickels' lives in Mexico. But is it too late to save any of them?

videos.title: Age of Anxiety
videos.overview: Jack hunts the cartel bagman Estuardo, but what he finds is worse then he could have ever imagined.

videos.title: Subterranean Fire
videos.overview: As Jack and Angela prepare to face the consequences of their actions, a discovery prompts Jack to formulate a plan.

videos.title: Wild Flower
videos.overview: After a shocking tragedy, tensions run high as Jack and Angela are forced to reveal a devastating truth to Anna.
